name: Majoring in Minors
body:
Nature has many faces, but a mere mortal cannot expect to agree with the way all of them presents themselves to the outside world. Ergo, favoritism occurs. You prefer a particular minor aspect and can use it more often as a result.

Prerequisite(s): Animism class feature, know at least one minor aspect.

Benefit(s): Select one minor aspect you know. You may use that minor aspect an additional time per day.

Special: Majoring in Minors can be taken multiple times.

Each time, select a new minor aspect you know.

The Animist: Nature "Incarnate", Copyright 2015, Interjection Games, LLC? Author: Bradley Crouch.
